rtl_result.summary: Frozen manifest is insufficient to implement full specified behavior without adding interfaces/control signals not present in module contracts.

contract_checks.requirement: Implement all frozen operations including tiled GEMM over M,N,K with boundary masking and mandatory bias+ReLU
contract_checks.evidence: control_fsm ports expose only cfg_latched/cfg_error inputs and m0/n0/k_idx outputs; it has no M/K/N inputs, no handshake/status inputs from datapath, and no control outputs (step_en/clear_tile/stage enables), so required loop/schedule progression cannot be implemented from frozen interfaces.

contract_checks.requirement: Preserve module manifest exactly (no invented ports/modules)
contract_checks.evidence: To realize specified sequencing, top/control/compute blocks need additional frozen signals (e.g., runtime dims into controller, per-stage ready/valid coordination, tile/post/emit done handshakes). These are absent from declared ports.

contract_checks.requirement: Output ordering tile-major with boundary masking and legal-index emission only
contract_checks.evidence: output_unit only receives in_valid/in_data and single emit_enable bit; no tile indices or runtime M/N are provided at its interface, so deterministic global ordering/boundary decision cannot be derived internally from declared contract alone.

architecture_conflict.issue: Current frozen port contracts do not carry enough control/state information to implement the required tile loops, k-step handshakes, boundary masking, and stage progression while preserving architecture semantics.
architecture_conflict.evidence: 1) control_fsm lacks M/K/N inputs and datapath handshake inputs, yet must drive nested loops and stalls. 2) control_fsm exposes no control outputs (except counters) to drive pe_array step_en/clear_tile or post/emit phases. 3) output_unit lacks index/context inputs for boundary masking/order derivation. 4) pe_array requires step_en/clear_tile but their source/control timing is not representable via existing inter-module contracts.
architecture_conflict.requested_architect_decision: Freeze additional interfaces/control ownership: (a) provide control_fsm inputs for M_reg/K_reg/N_reg and stage handshake/status, and outputs for step_en/clear_tile/post_valid sequencing; (b) define where tm_idx/tn_idx live and expose them; (c) provide output_unit with sufficient index/context (or move boundary/order control to top) to enforce tile-major masked emission deterministically.

known_risks: Any attempt to proceed without these decisions would require inventing hidden control behavior, violating frozen-architecture rules.
